name: dca_versus_lump_sum_commission_waiver_gain
question_template: Apply only this fictional scenario-local investment comparison. An investor commits {M} USD per month for four months. Under dollar-cost averaging, each monthly amount is used to buy shares at that month's price: month 1 at {P1}, month 2 at {P2}, month 3 at {P3}, month 4 at {P4} USD per share. Under the lump-sum alternative, the entire four-month total is used in a single purchase at the month-1 price. A flat commission of {FEE} USD is deducted from the cash of each purchase before shares are bought, but it is waived for any single purchase whose cash before commission is at least {WAIVE} USD, equality included. Shares are fractional. The dollar-cost-averaging average cost per share equals the total cash committed over the four months, including any commission, divided by the total shares bought. At the final price of {PF} USD per share, the gain of dollar-cost averaging relative to the lump sum is the market value of the dollar-cost-averaging shares minus the market value of the lump-sum shares; it is signed and may be negative. Report total dollar-cost-averaging shares, the dollar-cost-averaging average cost per share, lump-sum shares, and the signed gain in USD.

slots.description: Total shares bought across the four monthly purchases
Average cost per share under dollar-cost averaging including commission
Shares bought by the single lump-sum purchase at month-1 price

program:
def net_cash(cash, fee, waive):
    if cash >= waive:
        return cash
    return cash - fee

def solve():
    m = P["M"]
    prices = [P["P1"], P["P2"], P["P3"], P["P4"]]
    pf = P["PF"]
    fee = P["FEE"]
    waive = P["WAIVE"]
    if fee >= m:
        raise ValueError("commission must be smaller than the monthly contribution")
    dca_shares = 0
    for p in prices:
        dca_shares = dca_shares + net_cash(m, fee, waive) / p
    total_cash = 4 * m
    dca_avg_cost = total_cash / dca_shares
    ls_shares = net_cash(total_cash, fee, waive) / prices[0]
    gain = (dca_shares - ls_shares) * pf
    return {
        "final": gain,
        "dca_shares": dca_shares,
        "dca_avg_cost": dca_avg_cost,
        "ls_shares": ls_shares
    }
